question: When we practice and perform a dance together with our friends, what is it called? 👯‍♀️
explanation: Awesome! When many friends come together to dance in harmony, it is called a group dance! 👯‍♀️
hint: The word means 'more than one person'.

question: What is very important when we do a group dance? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Teamwork helps everyone move together nicely and make the dance look beautiful! 🌟

question: How should we feel when we dance together with our friends? 😄
explanation: Super! Dancing with our friends brings joy and makes us feel very happy and excited! 🎉
hint: It is a feeling of big joy.

question: What helps everyone in the group dance at the exact same time? 🎵
explanation: Excellent! Listening to the music beat helps all dancers match their steps perfectly! 🥁
hint: You hear it with your ears.

question: When dancing with a partner, what should we try to match? 👣
explanation: Awesome! Matching our dance steps makes the partner dance look perfectly in sync! ✨
hint: It is how we move our feet.

question: What fun shape can we make by holding hands in a big group? ⭕
explanation: Great job! Holding hands in a circle is a fun way to share energy and see everyone! 🌍
hint: It is round like the sun.

question: Where should we look to follow our partner's movements? 👀
explanation: Super! Looking at our partner helps us coordinate and smile at each other! 😊
hint: Keep your eyes on your friend.

question: What should we have on our faces when we perform a happy dance? 😊
explanation: Brilliant! A bright smile shows the audience that we love dancing together! 🌟
hint: It shows you are very happy.

question: How do we get better at dancing together? ⏰
explanation: Awesome! Practicing together every day makes our group dance completely perfect! 🏆

question: When everyone does the exact same dance move, what is it called? 👯‍♂️
explanation: Great job! Dancing 'in sync' means everyone moves together like one big team! ✨

question: What can we do to safely hold onto our friends during a circle dance? 👫
explanation: Super! Holding hands safely connects us and makes the circle strong and fun! ⭕

question: What is a fun sound we can make with our hands while dancing? 👏
explanation: Excellent! Clapping to the beat adds beautiful rhythm and energy to our dance! 🎵
hint: You bring your palms together quickly.

question: Why is it important to leave some space between dancers? 📏
explanation: Awesome! Keeping a safe distance means we will not bump into our friends while spinning! 🌀

question: What do we call the beautiful designs dancers make on the stage? 🌟
explanation: Great job! Formations are the lovely shapes like stars or lines that dancers make together! ✨
hint: They are shapes made by people.

question: What do we wear to make our group dance look colorful and matching? 👗
explanation: Super! Wearing matching costumes makes the group look like one beautiful dancing family! 🌈

question: When a friend does a beautiful new step, what should we do? 👀
explanation: Brilliant! We can learn so many fun new moves by observing our talented friends! 🧠

question: What is a nice way to end our group dance together? 🙇‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! Bowing together is a polite way to say thank you to the clapping audience! 👏

question: If we make a tiny mistake in the dance, what should we do? 😊
explanation: Great job! Everyone makes mistakes! Just keep smiling and jump right back into the dance! 🌟

question: If your partner forgets a step, how can you help? 🤝
explanation: Super! Good dance partners always help and gently support each other on stage! 🥰
hint: Be kind and show the way.

question: When we copy exactly what our partner does, we are acting like a what? 🪞
explanation: Excellent! Mirroring is a fun dance game where we match every single move our friend makes! ✨

question: To make the dance look amazing, everyone must start at the exact same what? 🚦
explanation: Awesome! Starting exactly on the same beat makes the group look super powerful! 💥

question: What is it called when two people dance beautifully together? 👫
explanation: Great job! A pair dance or duet is a special dance shared between two wonderful partners! 🌟

question: What object can we all hold to make our group dance extra fun? 🌂
explanation: Super! Dancing with matching props like ribbons or umbrellas makes the performance so exciting! 🎀
hint: An item you hold during a performance.

question: When dancing, what body parts do we tap on the floor to the beat? 👞
explanation: Brilliant! Tapping our feet together makes a wonderful rhythm for our group dance! 🎵

question: What is a fun, energetic move where we all leave the floor together? ⬆️
explanation: Awesome! Jumping high into the air at the exact same time looks absolutely magical! ✨

question: What cool move goes round and round in circles? 🌀
explanation: Great job! Spinning together creates a beautiful twirling effect on the stage! 🌪️

question: If the whole group takes steps to the front, they are moving where? ➡️
explanation: Super! Moving forward together brings the dance closer to the happy audience! 🎭

question: What is a gentle, rocking movement from side to side called? ↔️
explanation: Excellent! Swaying together like trees in the wind is a very beautiful dance move! 🌳

question: Who enjoys watching our beautiful group dances? 👀
explanation: Awesome! The audience loves watching our teamwork and gives us big cheers! 👏

question: Having lots of enthusiasm in a dance is called having big what? ⚡
explanation: Great job! Big energy makes the dance super exciting and fun for everyone to watch! 💥

question: To catch the beat, we must use our ears to do what? 👂
explanation: Super! Listening carefully to the drums helps us know exactly when to step! 🥁

question: When our group moves like gentle water, the steps are what? 🌊
explanation: Brilliant! Smooth, flowing steps make the dance look incredibly graceful and pretty! 🦢

question: How do we treat our dance partners? 💖
explanation: Awesome! Treating partners with respect means we are kind and share the dance space nicely! 🥰

question: What is it fun to do when watching a different dance style? 🆕
explanation: Great job! Seeing new styles is a wonderful way to learn fun, new ways to move! 🧠

question: When the dance is totally finished, what do the dancers do? 🎊
explanation: Super! Finishing a dance is a huge success, so we celebrate our amazing teamwork! 🎉
hint: Have a little party or cheer.

question: When one dancer moves and then the next dancer copies, they are taking what? 🔄
explanation: Excellent! Taking turns makes a fun dance game where everyone gets a chance to shine! 🌟

question: What can we do to support our dancing friends from the side? 📣
explanation: Awesome! Cheering makes our friends feel confident and happy while they perform! 👏

question: What is it called when you completely believe your partner will help you? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Trust is very important so partners can do fun and safe moves together! 🛡️

question: We can use our dance moves to tell the audience a what? 📖
explanation: Super! Dance is a beautiful language that tells magical stories using just our bodies! ✨
hint: It has a beginning and an end.

question: We use our faces and hands during dance to show our what? 🎭
explanation: Brilliant! Expressions help us show feelings like joy or surprise in our lovely dance! 😊

question: To not fall over during a spin, we must keep our what? ⚖️
explanation: Awesome! Keeping balance helps us stand tall and finish our cool spins safely! 🌀

question: When all the dancers blend together perfectly, it creates beautiful what? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Harmony is when all the different dancers look like one perfect moving picture! 🌟

question: To remember all the steps, we must always stay what? 🎯
explanation: Super! Focusing means paying close attention to the music and our wonderful team! 🧠

question: Dance steps that are light and bouncy are very what? 🎈
explanation: Excellent! Playful steps bring so much fun and joy to everyone dancing and watching! 😄

question: Moving our hands softly like flying birds is called having what? 👐
explanation: Awesome! Graceful hands make our beautiful group dance look very elegant and smooth! 🦢

question: What is the best part about doing a group dance? 🎉
explanation: Great job! The most important rule of any dance is to always have lots of fun! 😄

question: If our partner has a different dance style, we should think it is what? 🌟
explanation: Super! Everyone dances differently, and sharing our unique styles is very special! ✨

question: When dancers line up behind each other, what shape do they make? ➖
explanation: Awesome! A line formation looks so neat and keeps everyone in perfect order! 📏

question: What do we say to our teacher after a great dance practice? 🙏
explanation: Great job! We always say thank you to our teachers for helping us learn beautiful steps! 🥰

question: What do the happy audience members do at the end of the dance? 👏
explanation: Super! The audience claps loudly to show they loved your amazing teamwork and dancing! 🎉
